name: Adaptive Survivor
body:
Prerequisite(s): Shadow level 5th, Survival 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Choose one type of terrain from the ranger’s favored terrain list. You gain a +2 bonus on Stealth checks in the chosen terrain. Once per day, you can change your chosen terrain by spending 1 hour acclimating to a new environment.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times.

Its effects stack, granting an additional +2 bonus in the chosen terrain, up to a maximum of +6.

Alternatively, you can choose a new terrain type each time.
